args.title: Fix password reset email to use correct base URL instead of localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently uses a base URL that defaults to localhost if the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes links in the email to be unusable for users when the app is deployed. The change proposes to ensure the BASE_URL is correctly set from the environment or config, and to verify that the reset-password email links are generated using the correct base URL for the deployment environment.
